Outcome.Analysis: S0001 is the document title, formatted in bold and centered, clearly serving as the main structural heading. S0002 ('Opening:') and S0004 ('Attendance:') are bold, left-aligned labels that introduce distinct content blocks (opening remarks and attendee lists), functioning as section headings. S0010 and S0012 begin with inline structural labels ('Governance/Voting Rights.' and 'Subsequent Note:') that divide and name specific units of content within the minutes; per the instruction, only the heading portion is selected. The formatting change offsets at positions 26 and 17 respectively confirm where the heading text ends and body text begins. For S0012, the label is 'Subsequent Note:' followed by a space before the body text starts. The extent must not include trailing whitespace, so the end offset is adjusted to exclude the space after the colon. The remaining targets (S0003, S0005-S0009, S0011, S0013) are body paragraphs or list items describing meeting proceedings and do not serve a structural heading function.

Reasons.S0001: Bold, centered title introducing the entire document content.
Reasons.S0002: Bold label introducing the opening section of the minutes.
Reasons.S0004: Bold label introducing the attendance list section.
Reasons.S0010: Inline structural label dividing content into the Governance/Voting Rights discussion unit.
Reasons.S0012: Inline structural label introducing the subsequent note unit.
